title: Small-chunk localized evaluation is a weak exponential
statement:
Use combinatorial simplicial model categories and projective enriched diagrams of [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus], and Dwyer--Kan homotopy theory and enriched localization of [lem-coef-simplicial-localization-comparison-calculus]. Fix universes, a combinatorial simplicial model category $\mathcal M$, and small simplicial categories $I,J$. A chunk $U\subseteq\mathcal M$ means a full simplicial subcategory with these closure properties, with choices functorial by enriched functors: every finite fan $X\to Y_i$ in $U$ has a factorization $X\to Z\to\prod_iY_i$ as a trivial cofibration followed by a fibration with $Z\in U$, and every finite cofan $Y_i\to X$ has a factorization $\coprod_iY_i\to Z\to X$ as a cofibration followed by a trivial fibration with $Z\in U$; empty families are included. For a small simplicial category $I$, $U^I$ denotes the full enriched subcategory of $\mathcal M^I$ of diagrams valued in $U$. An $I$-chunk means that $U$ is a chunk and $U^I$ is a chunk in the projective model structure.

Let $U$ be a small chunk which is an $I$-chunk, and put $U_f^I=U^I\cap(\mathcal M^I)^f$, $E_U(I)=U_f^I[W_I^{-1}]$, and $X_U=U^f[W_U^{-1}]$, where the distinguished arrows are the model weak equivalences. For an enriched functor $v:J\to I$, put
$$P_U(I,J)=(U_f^I\times J)[V^{-1}],\qquad V=\{(w,1_j):w\in W_I,\ j\in\operatorname{Ob}J\}.$$
Projection to the two factors gives a canonical Dwyer--Kan equivalence
$$P_U(I,J)\longrightarrow E_U(I)\times J,$$
and the latter ordinary product represents the homotopy product. Evaluation $(F,j)\mapsto F(vj)$ induces an enriched map $P_U(I,J)\to X_U$. These diagrams are functorial under restriction in $I$, change of $J$, and full inclusions of chunks whenever the indicated chunks exist.

If $I$ is cofibrant in the Dwyer--Kan model structure and $v=1_I$, this evaluation exhibits $E_U(I)$ as a weak exponential of $X_U$ by $I$. Explicitly the evaluation span induces, for every small simplicial category $T$, a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{h\mathrm{sCat}}(T,E_U(I))\ \cong\ \operatorname{Hom}_{h\mathrm{sCat}}(T\times^h I,X_U),$$
natural in $T$, where $h\mathrm{sCat}$ is the ordinary homotopy category of the Dwyer--Kan model structure and $\times^h$ denotes its homotopy product. The evaluation is the one induced from the actual enriched mapping sets, rather than from a coherent nerve.
